1. What happens to a one-character purpose on a single outbound call with default validation and with strict validation?
2. Can I invent {{appointment_time}} and [BOOK_NOW]? How do CSV, single calls and keypad presses differ?
3. Which outbound placeholders need no CSV value? What about caller_name, business_name and caller_history?
4. Does reuse_campaign_id edit a voice or SMS campaign, and can I replay a finished campaign?
5. Two numbers on a shared agent use one Cal.com connection but need different booking zones. What do I set, clear and read back? How do Google Calendar and general phone time differ?
6. Our Help inbox is paged. How can we check an open conversation outside that page, who can see it, and what happens when we close a chat?
7. My personal Help reply timed out and I switched organisations. How do I recover the original write? What do a 200, a 404 and a 409 account_changed tell me? How would an organisation-key client recover?
8. How can my app import a customer’s own number using the API?
9. Which base URL can an ordinary developer use? Does the existence of staging give me a public sandbox?
10. Can I fetch ready-to-paste website install HTML for each tenant from the public API?
11. Does [TRANSFER] always use the agent’s shared destination? Can I make this tenant-specific?
12. Can an API-imported number send an in-call SMS, and which number sends it?
13. Can each number on our shared agent set a different phone greeting, language, general timezone and pickup delay?
14. Does an agent catalogue voice always beat a number’s voice_id?
15. Can two numbers on one agent use different knowledge or turn it off just for one number?
16. A recipient texts STOP to business A or objects in their own words. What can the customer switch on? Can business B on the same account contact them? How do I filter evidence and correct a genuine AI mistake?
17. While moving or cancelling an appointment on a voice call, the lookup now shows a changed appointment. Does the earlier yes count? When can the agent say the change succeeded?
18. How do I verify and route call.bookings across tenants? Can I get a number-specific secret?
19. If a shared agent has two attached numbers and one is disabled, what happens when I omit from_number with the sender rule off and on? Who can change it, and what should a multi-tenant app send?
20. How do I scope voice campaigns, SMS pages, opt-out evidence, inbox and call history to one business number? Can that filter restrict bulk call deletion?
21. How many agents may we sell, and is there a per-agent fee?
22. Can we reserve calls at once per number?
23. Can my app rely on a 12,000-character custom_prompt today?
24. For an inbound call, do tenant instructions replace all the shared agent instructions?
25. If we write our customer’s facts only in the phone profile, do SMS and the web widget automatically reuse them?
26. Will an outbound call automatically include the number’s inbound profile or the agent’s inbound instructions?
27. A recipient is missing {{appointment_time}}. Is it safe to let the dial proceed?
28. For one sender, there was one six-second call with no detected voicemail, one voicemail and one failed start. What is pickup rate? What if there were no attempts? Can I total a bounded list for the whole account, or calculate SMS delivery the same way?
29. Can the website chat book through the built-in calendar integration like telephone calls or SMS?
30. If require_booking_confirmation is false, can a phone agent skip the read-back when making a new booking?
